metrics.name: Appointment no-show rate
metrics.summary: No-shows / (kept + no-shows) among distinct appointments scheduled in the period; cancelled and rescheduled appointments are outside the denominator. Statuses resolved per appointment_id across all versions.

denominator.summary: Distinct appointment_ids that were kept (arrived/fulfilled) or no-show.

numerator.summary: Denominator appointments with any no_show version.

metrics.sql_template: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(ever_no_show) / count(*), 1) AS no_show_rate FROM appointment WHERE scheduled_date BETWEEN '{period_start}' AND '{period_end}' AND (kept = 1 OR ever_no_show = 1)

metrics.name: Stale booked appointments
metrics.internal_reason: Scheduling data-quality worklist; no published standard.
metrics.summary: Distinct appointment_ids whose only received status in any version is 'booked' and whose scheduled_date is before the as-of date (statuses can arrive out of order, so the latest-arrival status is not used). Appointments without a scheduled date are excluded.

numerator.summary: appointment_ids with no non-booked version and scheduled_date < as-of.

checks.why: final_status is the latest-arriving status; statuses arrive out of order, so 'still booked' means no other status in ANY version

metrics.sql_template: SELECT count(*) AS stale_booked FROM (SELECT json_extract(payload,'$.appointment_id') AS appointment_id, max(json_extract(payload,'$.scheduled_date')) AS scheduled_date, sum(json_extract(payload,'$.status') <> 'booked') AS other_statuses FROM record WHERE stream = 'appointments' GROUP BY 1) WHERE other_statuses = 0 AND scheduled_date < '{as_of}'

metrics.name: Community service referrals sent and delivered, by service
metrics.internal_reason: Social-care referral closed-loop metric; Gravity Project / CMS AHC conventions name the concept but fix no counting rule.
metrics.summary: By service requested: community_service_referrals records (by record_id) and how many have ANY community_service_outcomes record (linked by referral_record_id) with service_delivered = true. Scheduled, waitlisted, declined and unable-to-reach outcomes are not delivered. Clinic-internal referrals are not community referrals.

checks.why: delivery is recorded on community_service_outcomes (linked by referral_record_id), not on the referral record
clinic-internal referrals (referrals stream) are not community referrals

metrics.sql_template: SELECT json_extract(r.payload,'$.service_requested') AS service, count(*) AS referrals, sum(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM record o WHERE o.stream = 'community_service_outcomes' AND json_extract(o.payload,'$.referral_record_id') = r.record_id AND json_extract(o.payload,'$.service_delivered') = 1)) AS delivered FROM record r WHERE r.stream = 'community_service_referrals' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

metrics.name: Duplicate lab rows
metrics.summary: Among lab rows with a draw time, extra copies sharing patient, test, draw time (event_time) and value: sum over groups of (rows - 1). Rows differing only by record_id are duplicates; same-day draws at different times are not.

numerator.summary: Rows beyond the first in each (patient, test, event_time, value) group.

metrics.sql_template: SELECT coalesce(sum(n - 1), 0) AS duplicate_lab_rows FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM measurement WHERE source_table = 'labs' AND event_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY patient_id, name, event_time, value)

metrics.name: Food insecurity rate among screened patients
metrics.internal_reason: Screening-positive rate over social_need (instruments normalised by Agere); AHC HRSN names the domain but the rate convention is ours.
metrics.summary: Percent of patients screened for food need (any social_need row with need = 'food') with a positive food screen.

population.summary: Patients with a food-need screening answer.

denominator.summary: Distinct patients screened for food need.

numerator.summary: Of those, distinct patients with any positive food screen.

metrics.sql_template: SELECT round(100.0 * count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN positive = 1 THEN patient_id END) / count(DISTINCT patient_id), 1) AS food_insecurity_pct FROM social_need WHERE need = 'food'
